title: [DEV] AAPSclient misses downloads
body:
AAPS 3.2.0-dev-m 44b8b30-2023.10.13 NSClientV3 + websockets
NS dev v15 2757fe5
Time 2023-10-17 around 05:25
[Log Export.txt](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/12924856/Log.Export.txt)
Similar to #2748

Happened this morning after turning on the AAPSclient device. Data is in NS, but TBR won't download. Missing data won't backfill, even if I force close AAPSclient, delete cache and restart NSClient.
